title: Location for new windmills
description: Given an area, calculate the best place to put new windmills based on available data, constraints and a totally bogus scientific methodology.

uri.title: Features endpoint
uri.description: URI of an OGC API Features collection or /items endpoint.

name.title: Output collection name
name.description: Optional filename (without extension) for the GeoJSON file written to the datasets folder. Defaults to {collectionId}_sample.

collection.title: Sampled collection
collection.description: The sampled features as an OGC API Features collection. Inline collection metadata (value) or a link (reference).

items.title: Sampled features
items.description: The sampled features as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Inline GeoJSON (value) or a link to the items resource (reference).
